name: Zerili
description: A young scholar who argued for a treaty with the minotaurs and was found mutilated a week later.

timeline.summary: The scholar Zerili argues for a treaty with the minotaurs and is found murdered and mutilated that week.
timeline.quote: the young man's mutilated corpse was found later that week

timeline.summary: The narrator searches Zerili's home and ledger and concludes that the village secretly pays human tribute and that Vinack means him to die.
timeline.quote: Vinack meant for me to die.

relations.note: His mutilated corpse was found after he asked to speak to them.
relations.quote: arms torn from his torso with the palms toward the sky

pages_say.description: A young scholar who argued for a treaty with the minotaurs and was found mutilated a week later.
